Glizard the Frankfurter Mage.summary: A smooth reddish-brown tubular frankfurter with dot eyes and pursed mouth, wearing a navy star-dusted wizard robe and conical floppy hat.
Glizard the Frankfurter Mage.pose: Upright contrapposto sausage with spindly noodle legs, presenting an open palm that suspends an icy blue flame while facing slightly west.

brush-flick-spire.summary: An upward-tapering curved monolithic blade of glossy black-indigo ink lacquer stone with a sharp calligraphic flick at its peak.

star-doodle-totem.summary: A slender blue obelisk topped with stacked chunky faceted five-pointed gold stars drawn as interlocking child-like lines.

cyan-ember-pillar.summary: A smooth ice-cyan tiered magical flame floating above a dark stone bowl pedestal, echoing the wizard's hovering palm flame.

gnarled-staff-perch.summary: A sinuous, faceted wooden staff composed of linked crooked orange-brown beams with a crooked crook at the head.

things.text: A curl of dried ink, peeled off the Ribbonway.
